picks.title: Commission holds special meeting of Scientific panel on frontier AI safety and risks
picks.excerpt: The European Commission convened a special meeting of its Scientific Panel on AI, which has been investigating recent loss-of-control incidents and, with the AI Office, drafted questions for the companies that developed the models involved.
picks.rationale: Primary EU release: the Commission's AI Scientific Panel is formally examining loss-of-control incidents and, with the AI Office, has drafted questions for the model developers involved, an early step in AI Act oversight of frontier models.

picks.title: Disrupting AI-enabled "false front" operations
picks.excerpt: OpenAI says it disrupted two AI-enabled influence operations that used false-front journalists and a think tank to spread geopolitical messaging. Company-attributed claims.
picks.rationale: Primary threat report on AI-driven influence operations: OpenAI says it took down two networks that used fake journalists and a fake think tank (claims attributed to OpenAI), which is concrete evidence on the public-opinion axis.

picks.title: EU cyber and science researchers are testing Chinese AI models
picks.excerpt: The EU's cyber agency ENISA and the Joint Research Centre confirm for the first time that they are testing Chinese open-source AI models.
picks.rationale: Official confirmation: ENISA and the JRC say for the first time that they are testing Chinese open-weight models, which signals how EU institutions will vet Chinese AI.

picks.title: 경찰, '딥페이크·관권선거 의혹' 박완수 경남지사 피의자 조사
picks.excerpt: 경찰이 6·3 지방선거 당시 박완수 경남지사 후보 캠프의 '딥페이크 영상·관권선거 의혹'과 관련해 박 지사를 피의자 신분으로 조사했다. 경남선관위가 공직선거법 위반 혐의로 수사 의뢰한 사건이다.
picks.rationale: Concrete law-enforcement step on an election deepfake case: police questioned a sitting governor as a suspect after the provincial election commission referred alleged deepfake-video use and official-power campaigning. These are allegations only, attributed to police and the commission, with no finding of guilt.

picks.title: Ukraine's drones knock out AI data center belonging to "Russia's Google"
picks.excerpt: Ukrainian drone strikes hit a Yandex AI data center, making AI compute infrastructure an explicit military target in the Russia-Ukraine war.
picks.rationale: AI geopolitics as a concrete event: a strike on Yandex's AI data center shows AI compute being treated as a military target in a war.
